websiteHomeTitle.message: SiteMark: never confuse production with test again
websiteHomeTitle.description: Browser tab title of the website home page. At most 60 characters.

websiteHomeHeading.message: Never confuse production with test again
websiteHomeHeading.description: Main heading (h1) of the website home page.

websiteHomeHeadingMark.description: The word of the home page heading (h1) that sits on a highlighter stroke. It must appear in the heading as written.

websiteHomeLead.message: SiteMark is a private browser extension that marks the websites you choose with ribbons, banners and outlines, so you always know where you are. It collects nothing and only runs on the sites you allow.
websiteHomeLead.description: One-sentence value proposition below the home page heading.

websiteSkipToContent.description: Skip link, the first thing keyboard users reach on every page. Jumps to the main content.

websiteHeaderHome.description: Text alternative of the SiteMark wordmark in the header, which links to the home page.

websiteNavSupport.description: Navigation link to the support and contact page.

websiteNavPrivacy.description: Navigation link to the privacy policy.

websiteNavChangelog.description: Footer link to the changelog (the list of changes per release).

websiteNavAgents.description: Footer link to the page for AI agents and the people who ask them.

websiteNavGitHub.description: Header link to the public repository of SiteMark on GitHub.

websiteLanguageLabel.description: Accessible name of the language switch (EN / NL).

websiteLanguageNameEn.description: Name of the English version in the language switch. Always written in English itself.

websiteLanguageNameNl.description: Name of the Dutch version in the language switch. Always written in Dutch itself.

websiteFooterLabel.description: Accessible name of the link list in the page footer.

websiteFooterGitHub.description: Footer link to the SiteMark repository on GitHub.

websiteFooterSitemap.description: Footer link to sitemap.xml, the list of all pages for search engines.

websiteFooterLicense.description: Footer link to the license of SiteMark.

websiteFooterPortfolio.description: Footer link to the maker's portfolio website, nielsvanbrakel.com.

websiteFooterMadeIn.message: Made by Niels van Brakel in the Netherlands.
websiteFooterMadeIn.description: Footer line that names the maker and controller (as in the privacy policy).

websiteThemeLabel.description: Accessible name of the theme switch in the header (system / light / dark).

websiteHomeDescription.message: SiteMark marks production and other websites with ribbons, banners and outlines, so you never confuse environments. Free, private and source-available.
websiteHomeDescription.description: Meta description of the website home page, shown in search results. At most 160 characters.

websiteSocialImageAlt.message: The SiteMark logo next to a browser window marked with a ribbon and a banner
websiteSocialImageAlt.description: Text alternative of the preview image that social networks show when someone shares a website link.

websitePrivacyTitle.description: Browser tab title of the privacy policy page. At most 60 characters.

websitePrivacyDescription.message: The SiteMark privacy policy: the extension and the website collect no data, set no cookies and make no third-party requests.
websitePrivacyDescription.description: Meta description of the privacy policy page, shown in search results. At most 160 characters.

websiteSupportTitle.description: Browser tab title of the support page. At most 60 characters.

websiteSupportDescription.message: Get help with SiteMark: report a bug or ask for a feature on GitHub, report security problems privately and read answers to common questions.
websiteSupportDescription.description: Meta description of the support page, shown in search results. At most 160 characters.

websiteSupportLead.message: All contact goes through GitHub. SiteMark is maintained in spare time, so answers can take a few days.
websiteSupportLead.description: Introduction of the support page: contact goes through GitHub, and the response time expectation.

websiteSupportCalloutTitle.message: Security problem? Don't open a public issue.
websiteSupportCalloutTitle.description: Title of the warning box on the support page about reporting security problems privately.

websiteSupportCalloutText.message: Anyone can read public issues. Report security problems privately through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, so they can be fixed before others learn about them.
websiteSupportCalloutText.description: Text of the warning box on the support page. 'GitHub private vulnerability reporting' is the name of a GitHub feature.

websiteSupportSecurityPolicyLink.description: Link to SECURITY.md in the repository, inside the security warning box.

websiteSupportContactHeading.description: Heading of the contact block at the bottom of the help and support page.

websiteSupportBugLink.description: Link to the GitHub bug report form.

websiteSupportBugText.message: Something doesn't work as expected? Fill in the bug report form on GitHub.
websiteSupportBugText.description: When to use the bug report form.

websiteSupportFeatureLink.description: Link to the GitHub feature request form.

websiteSupportFeatureText.message: Missing something? Some things are out of scope on purpose: cloud sync, accounts, analytics and broad site access.
websiteSupportFeatureText.description: When to use the feature request form, and what is deliberately out of scope.

websiteSupportSecurityLink.description: Link to GitHub private vulnerability reporting for SiteMark.

websiteSupportSecurityText.message: Found a security problem? Only the maintainer sees these reports.
websiteSupportSecurityText.description: When to use private vulnerability reporting.

websiteBugReportHeading.message: What to include in a bug report
websiteBugReportHeading.description: Heading of the bug report checklist on the support page.

websiteBugReportBrowser.message: Your browser and its version, for example Chrome 131 or Firefox 142.
websiteBugReportBrowser.description: Bug report checklist item: browser and version.

websiteBugReportVersion.message: The SiteMark version, shown on your browser's extensions page.
websiteBugReportVersion.description: Bug report checklist item: SiteMark version.

websiteBugReportDiagnostics.message: The text from Copy diagnostics on the options page: the version, browser and status of permissions and marks, without full URLs.
websiteBugReportDiagnostics.description: Bug report checklist item: the Copy diagnostics text from the options page.

websiteBugReportSteps.message: What you did, what you expected and what happened instead.
websiteBugReportSteps.description: Bug report checklist item: steps and expected versus actual result.

websiteBugReportPrivate.message: No internal hostnames: prod.example.com works fine as a stand-in.
websiteBugReportPrivate.description: Bug report checklist item: don't share private hostnames in public issues.

websiteHomeHighlightsHeading.description: Visually hidden heading above the three highlight cards on the home page.

websiteHighlightUnmistakableTitle.description: Title of the first home page highlight card (marks are impossible to miss).

websiteHighlightUnmistakableText.message: Ribbons, banners, frames and outlines in colors you choose, so production never looks like test.
websiteHighlightUnmistakableText.description: One sentence on the first highlight card.

websiteHighlightSimpleTitle.description: Title of the second home page highlight card.

websiteHighlightSimpleText.message: Add a URL pattern, pick a mark and you're done: mark a whole page or just the button that matters.
websiteHighlightSimpleText.description: One sentence on the second highlight card.

websiteHighlightPrivateTitle.description: Title of the third home page highlight card.

websiteHighlightPrivateText.message: No accounts, no tracking and no network requests, and SiteMark only runs on the websites you allow.
websiteHighlightPrivateText.description: One sentence on the third highlight card.

websitePrivacySummaryHeading.description: Heading of the privacy summary on the home page.

websitePrivacySummaryText.message: SiteMark collects no data. Your site groups stay in your browser, and this website sets no cookies and loads nothing from anywhere else.
websitePrivacySummaryText.description: Privacy summary on the home page.

websitePrivacyFactOpenTitle.description: Title of a privacy fact card on the home page.

websitePrivacyFactOpenText.message: The code of the extension and this website is public on GitHub, so anyone can check what SiteMark does. All rights reserved.
websitePrivacyFactOpenText.description: One sentence on a privacy fact card on the home page.

websitePrivacyFactLocalTitle.description: Title of a privacy fact card on the home page.

websitePrivacyFactLocalText.message: Your site groups live in the extension's local storage and are never synced to a cloud account.
websitePrivacyFactLocalText.description: One sentence on a privacy fact card on the home page.

websitePrivacyFactNoTrackingTitle.description: Title of a privacy fact card on the home page.

websitePrivacyFactNoTrackingText.message: No accounts, trackers or servers of its own, and no remote code. The one exception is the favicon tint: off by default, and it only loads the icon of the site you are on.
websitePrivacyFactNoTrackingText.description: One sentence on a privacy fact card on the home page.

websitePrivacyPermissionsHeading.description: Heading or permission explanation in the home page privacy section.

websitePrivacyPermissionStorage.message: Keeps your site groups and settings in your browser.
websitePrivacyPermissionStorage.description: Heading or permission explanation in the home page privacy section.

websitePrivacyPermissionScripting.message: Shows marks on the pages that match your URL patterns.
websitePrivacyPermissionScripting.description: Heading or permission explanation in the home page privacy section.

websitePrivacyPermissionActiveTab.message: Lets you pick an element or mark a site, only after you click SiteMark or use its shortcut.
websitePrivacyPermissionActiveTab.description: Heading or permission explanation in the home page privacy section.

websitePrivacyPermissionHosts.message: Access to websites: never granted at install. SiteMark asks for one website at a time, when you add its URL pattern.
websitePrivacyPermissionHosts.description: Heading or permission explanation in the home page privacy section.

websitePrivacyPermissionWhenInstall.description: Chip on a permission in the home page privacy section: when it is granted.

websitePrivacyPermissionWhenClick.description: Chip on a permission in the home page privacy section: when it is granted.

websitePrivacyPermissionWhenSite.description: Chip on a permission in the home page privacy section: when it is granted.

websiteInstallLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of install buttons (one per browser store).

websiteInstallAdd.description: Install button that links to a browser store listing. $BROWSER$ is Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

websiteInstallComingLater.description: Disabled install button for a store that SiteMark supports later (Safari).

websiteInstallOnComputer.message: SiteMark installs on a computer. Open this page there.
websiteInstallOnComputer.description: Hint under the install buttons, shown to iPhone and iPad visitors: extensions can't be installed there.

websiteInstallAlso.description: Label before the install links of the other browsers, after the big button of the visitor's own browser.

websiteNotFoundHeading.description: Heading of the 404 page, which shows English and Dutch together. Also part of its title.

websiteNotFoundText.message: This page doesn't exist, or it has moved. These pages can help you on your way:
websiteNotFoundText.description: Text of the 404 page, above the links to the home, help and support pages.

websiteAtWorkHeading.description: Heading of the home page section that shows SiteMark at work.

websiteAtWorkLead.message: Same production tab, three kinds of marks. Flip the switch to see what SiteMark adds.
websiteAtWorkLead.description: Lead under the heading of the SiteMark at work section.

websiteAtWorkSwitch.description: Label of the on/off switch of the SiteMark at work notes. Keep the product name.

websiteAtWorkQuestionOff.description: Line above the three notes while the switch is off.

websiteAtWorkQuestionOn.message: Yes, and that is just three of many ways.
websiteAtWorkQuestionOn.description: Line above the three notes once the switch is on.

websiteAtWorkFaviconTitle.description: Title of the first note: the browser tab.

websiteAtWorkFaviconText.message: A coloured dot on the tab icon and a prefix in front of the title. Find the right tab among dozens at a glance.

websiteAtWorkFaviconAlt.message: A browser with several tabs. With SiteMark on, the production tab gets a red dot on its icon and a PROD prefix, so it stands out from the others.
websiteAtWorkFaviconAlt.description: Description of the favicon note. Never say screenshot.

websiteAtWorkPageTitle.description: Title of the second note: the whole page.

websiteAtWorkPageText.message: A ribbon, a banner, a frame, a tint, stripes or a watermark. Combine them in one of four colours or your own.

websiteAtWorkPageAlt.message: A page with a red frame, a PROD ribbon in the corner and a Production banner along the bottom edge, shown when SiteMark is on.
websiteAtWorkPageAlt.description: Description of the page note. Never say screenshot.

websiteAtWorkComponentTitle.description: Title of the third note: one element on the page.

websiteAtWorkComponentText.message: An outline, a tint, stripes or a ribbon on one button, field or panel, so the risky part stands out.

websiteAtWorkComponentAlt.message: A delete dialog. With SiteMark on, it gets a red outline and a PROD ribbon, so the risky part stands out.
websiteAtWorkComponentAlt.description: Description of the component note. Never say screenshot.

websiteAtWorkTabAdmin.description: Decorative title of the active tab in the favicon note.

websiteAtWorkTabMail.description: Decorative title of a second tab in the favicon note.

websiteAtWorkTabDocs.description: Decorative title of a third tab in the favicon note.

websiteAtWorkTabShop.description: Decorative title of a fourth tab in the favicon note.

websiteAtWorkMarkProd.description: Short text of the ribbons and the title prefix in the notes. Keep it short and capitalised.

websiteAtWorkMarkProduction.description: Text of the banner in the page note.

websiteAtWorkDialogTitle.description: Title of the example confirmation dialog in the component note.

websiteAtWorkDialogCancel.description: Cancel button of the example dialog (decorative).

websiteAtWorkDialogConfirm.description: Confirm button of the example dialog (decorative).

websiteHeroPlaygroundLink.message: Try your own mark in the playground
websiteHeroPlaygroundLink.description: Home hero: link under the small playground to the full playground page.
